claim: E1M5, a church map, is flicker-dense: 191 of its 429 sectors (44.5%) carry animated shade (candlelight), about 66 channels of its own. By share of animated sectors it is fifth in the campaign, after E3M3 (57%, a sewer), E1M8, E4M1 and E6M1. Its 683 sprites count 556 face- and 116 wall-aligned, but most are foes, pickups and control sprites: visible plain decoration is 38 face, 22 wall and 11 floor sprites.
